history.summary: A 904 sqft 2BR in Clementi at $1.3M / $1,438 PSF, slightly above the $1,380 URA median but on the strength of a notable +6.08%/yr appreciation over 47 transactions — the best rate in the batch. The offset is an ageing 99yr lease (built 1998, ~71yr left) and a 1.04km MRT walk, which is why the technical score is low (478) despite strong appreciation.
history.rating_rationale: The headline draw is a reliable +6.08%/yr URA CAGR (47 txns) — genuinely strong, reflecting Clementi/One-North demand. But PSF $1,438 is ~4% ABOVE the $1,380 median (not a discount), the lease is decaying (99yr from 1998, ~71yr now and ~64yr at a 5-7yr exit), and Clementi MRT is 1.04km (13-min walk). The low score_1000 of 478 captures these lease/location drags. Strong past appreciation vs ageing-lease headwind nets to a balanced Neutral.
